title: Position 1 full RF acquisition bundle before relocation
goal: Preserve useful per-position RF samples, uncertainty controls and source provenance before relocating the equipment.
hypothesis: Local frequency-response features may repeat at a spot and differ at other spots; assess instrumental variability before assigning changes to room geometry.

ground_truth.position: Original desk location; user confirmed fixed equipment during main run
ground_truth.operator: User confirmed stayed in place during main run

environment: Stock TX/RX antennas; Pluto near computer and router. Operator nearby.
calibration_state: Uncalibrated radio/antenna transfer, EIRP, delay and bearing. Independent capture phase/timing per tuning; no global coherence assumed.
authorization_and_limits: TX confined to candidate windows wholly inside 5725-5875 MHz.
Cellular, GNSS and observed occupied intervals excluded.
Hardware settings and finite receive checks do not calibrate EIRP or establish permanent vacancy.
No phase coherence across retunes or positions assumed.
No floor plan or calibrated ranges claimed from acquisition alone.

receive_guard.reason: Avoid measured receiver-edge noise rise; overlapping guards cover each other's RX DC gap and the full pilot span.

steps: RX-only 2.4 GHz context at gain 20 dB
RX-only 5.8 GHz survey offset from TX centers; reject observed occupied intervals
Legacy narrow pilot, two wideband anchors and attenuation controls
Ascending overlapping sweep; fresh RX guard before every RF burst
Repeated anchors and descending overlapping sweep
Final anchors, TX-off controls, restore and mute verification
constraints: TX confined to candidate windows wholly inside 5725-5875 MHz.
Cellular, GNSS and observed occupied intervals excluded.
Hardware settings and finite receive checks do not calibrate EIRP or establish permanent vacancy.
No phase coherence across retunes or positions assumed.
No floor plan or calibrated ranges claimed from acquisition alone.

raw_storage: data/local/ (ignored; includes failed attempts and reused survey provenance)
deviations: Initial activity guard included a receiver-edge rise; first pass transmitted nothing. RX-only diagnostic and offset guard redesign retained.
Buffer API mismatch stopped the second attempt before RF. Its recent complete passive survey was reused with hashes and fresh per-burst guards.

Windows metadata replacement lock stopped the first held-control run. Seven completed 5771.5 MHz bursts accepted; two partial 5800 MHz bursts retained; missing complete trains recollected at the same spot.
Averaged weak-pilot evidence rule added after observing weaker upper-frequency response; original conservative flags retained and synthetic noise/weak-pilot cases tested.
Metadata lock error has its absolute user directory redacted publicly; exact original saved locally.
uncertainties: Finite receive checks do not prove permanent spectrum vacancy.
Swept radio/antenna response includes unresolved direct coupling and multipath.
Retuned power varies more than held-frequency controls; time-scale differences confound attribution.
Overlap phase mismatch and nuisance timing prevent a validated coherent wideband range estimate.
warning_disposition: Retained >0.5 dB sweep-repeatability warning. Held controls establish lower short-term variation but do not correct or isolate the cause. Raw capture quality and coverage support leaving this spot; geometry inference remains unvalidated.
next_test: Repeat the same complete bundle at position 2 after operator placement and settling, recording approximate pose and position when available.
